ModMetaData.name: JustTerminalAI
ModMetaData.author: tiagocc0
ModMetaData.description:
Adds an ai command to JustTerminal. Write what you want in plain words and a language model running on your own computer does it with the terminal's commands.
ai who's the hungriest? ai make the miners work nights and sleep in the day ai tell me when someone gets the plague
It looks around with the read commands first, then shows the commands it wants to run and waits for y before it changes anything. It can also write cron scripts and programs in ~ for you.
Each ai line starts fresh. ai session turns the screen red and gives you an ai> prompt, then you just talk to it and it remembers the talk. exit or ctrl+c leaves.
ai remember Drill and Kovul are the miners keeps a line it reads before every answer, in a session you can also just tell it to remember something. ai memory lists them, d removes one, e edits them. They're in ~/ai.memory, so they belong to the save.
It needs a model server running, anything that answers like OpenAI: vLLM, llama.cpp server, LM Studio or Ollama. Set the address in the mod options, the default is http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1, and Test the server checks it. Nothing leaves your computer unless you point it somewhere else.
Small models get things wrong more often, a 7B or bigger works better. Keep ask first on.
